sql:
with o as (
  select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price, 100 - lo.limit_price yes_px,
         (extract(epoch from lo.created_at) * 1000)::bigint c_ms
  from live_orders lo
  where lo.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and lo.side = 'no' and lo.action = 'buy' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null
    and lo.created_at >= '2026-09-16T00:00:00Z'
), fe as (
  select kalshi_order_id, min(ts_ms) f_ms, array_agg(trade_id) tids from execution_fill_events
  where kalshi_order_id in (select kalshi_order_id from o) group by 1
), s as (
  select market_ticker, max(case when side = 'no' then resolved_value else 100 - resolved_value end) settle_no
  from paper_trades where resolved_value is not null and strategy like '%mmsell%' group by 1
), tr as (
  select t.market_ticker, t.ts_ms, t.yes_price_cents, t.count_fp, t.trade_id, t.taker_outcome_side,
         sum(t.count_fp) over (partition by t.market_ticker, t.yes_price_cents, t.taker_outcome_side
                               order by t.ts_ms range between 60000 preceding and current row) v60
  from execution_trade_events t
  where t.market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o)
)
select o.id, o.market_ticker, o.created_at::date d, o.limit_price, fe.f_ms - o.c_ms rest_ms,
       s.settle_no - o.limit_price c,
       (select min(tr.ts_ms) from tr where tr.market_ticker = o.market_ticker and tr.taker_outcome_side = 'yes'
          and tr.yes_price_cents >= o.yes_px and tr.ts_ms > o.c_ms and tr.ts_ms <= fe.f_ms
          and not (tr.trade_id = any(fe.tids))) t1_ms,
       (select min(tr.ts_ms) from tr where tr.market_ticker = o.market_ticker and tr.taker_outcome_side = 'yes'
          and tr.yes_price_cents >= o.yes_px and tr.ts_ms > o.c_ms and tr.ts_ms <= fe.f_ms and tr.v60 >= 50
          and not (tr.trade_id = any(fe.tids))) t2_ms,
       (select count(*) from tr where tr.market_ticker = o.market_ticker and tr.taker_outcome_side = 'yes'
          and tr.yes_price_cents >= o.yes_px and tr.ts_ms > o.c_ms and tr.ts_ms < fe.f_ms
          and not (tr.trade_id = any(fe.tids))) n_lvl,
       (select sum(tr.count_fp) from tr where tr.market_ticker = o.market_ticker and tr.ts_ms = fe.f_ms
          and tr.taker_outcome_side = 'yes') taker_sz,
       (select count(*) from tr where tr.market_ticker = o.market_ticker and tr.ts_ms < o.c_ms + 600000
          and tr.ts_ms > o.c_ms - 600000) cov
from o join fe using (kalshi_order_id) left join s using (market_ticker)
order by o.created_at
